evals.prompt: Sync post-planning GitLab issues from gitlab-issue-feature-map.md for version 1.1.0.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads config, validates milestone, batch updates issues with atomic labels per Flow A.

evals.prompt: Task 008 started — update linked GitLab issue to in progress before coding.
evals.expected_output: Agent Flow B start transition backlog→in_progress only, records start timestamp.

evals.prompt: Mark GitLab issue done for completed task — skip in progress, it's faster.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses anti-pattern; requires in_progress step and spent time comment.

evals.prompt: Flow A sync — linked task says Estimate 3600 but GitLab issue already has a 4h estimate.
evals.expected_output: Agent skips set_issue_estimate; preserves existing time_stats.time_estimate.

evals.prompt: Task 012 started. Use set_issue_labels to remove the backlog status label and add the in-progress one on its GitLab issue; status label names are not in gitlab-sync-config.md yet, so look them up.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses set_issue_status (not set_issue_labels) for the Status label; does not call a label-listing tool or guess names; asks the human once to confirm the status label names and records them in docs/context/gitlab-sync-config.md.

evals.prompt: Re-run Flow A post-planning sync for version 1.1.0; some mapped issues are already in progress or done on the board.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads each issue's current Status label first; sets status_backlog only on issues with no Status label or already backlog; leaves in-progress/done/blocked issues unchanged and reports them; still applies milestone and non-status labels.
